title: Add expiry and complete deletion
description:
## What to build

Documents never expire by default. An editor can set a local date/time expiry; access stops exactly at that time; manual deletion and the daily Vercel cleanup remove Document and image records.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A Share Link returns the same unavailable response for a deleted or expired Document immediately after its expiry time.
- [ ] Expired and deleted Documents, including their pasted images, are removed by the cleanup process within 24 hours.

## Blocked by

- Add separate Edit Links and manual publishing.
- Support private pasted images.
acceptance_criteria: Optional expiry and complete Document deletion work end to end.

title: Apply privacy, abuse, and public-information controls
description:
## What to build

MarkShare has no analytics or content logging; protects Share Links from search indexing and referrer leakage; gives private generic link previews; applies Vercel protection and rate limits; and publishes About, Privacy, and Acceptable Use pages.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Share Links do not expose Document titles or content to search engines, link previews, referrers, analytics, or application logs.
- [ ] Public creation and image upload are rate-limited, and the public-information pages describe the agreed service behaviour.

## Blocked by

- Create and read a basic Markdown Document.
- Support private pasted images.
- Add expiry and complete deletion.
acceptance_criteria: The agreed privacy and abuse controls work end to end.

title: Production-readiness and handover
description:
## What to build

Verify the finished MarkShare flows end to end, including accessibility and mobile behaviour; complete production deployment configuration; and document manual InstantDB export and recovery steps.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The supported creation, editing, reading, image, expiry, deletion, privacy, and theme flows are verified in a production-like deployment.
- [ ] An owner can follow concise guidance to export data and understand the recovery limits of version one.

## Blocked by

- Make the editor resilient and responsive.
- Support private pasted images.
- Add expiry and complete deletion.
- Apply privacy, abuse, and public-information controls.
acceptance_criteria: MarkShare is ready to launch and hand over.

title: Support private pasted images
description:
## What to build

Authors can paste or drag PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF images into a Document. MarkShare stores them privately in InstantDB, inserts Markdown automatically, and serves them only through an available Share Link.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Pasting or dropping a supported image inserts it into the editor and renders it for readers.
- [ ] The 5 MB per-image and 20 images per-Document limits are enforced, and image access does not become public through a standalone file URL.

## Blocked by

- Add separate Edit Links and manual publishing.
- Deliver the complete Markdown reading experience.
acceptance_criteria: Private pasted-image sharing works end to end.

title: Make the editor resilient and responsive
description:
## What to build

The editor provides side-by-side Write and Preview on desktop, Edit and Preview tabs on mobile, browser-local recovery for unpublished work, and import of existing Markdown files.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The authoring flow is usable on current desktop and mobile browsers.
- [ ] Unsaved local work recovers after an accidental close, but public content changes only after Save changes.

## Blocked by

- Add separate Edit Links and manual publishing.
- Deliver the complete Markdown reading experience.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive authoring, local draft recovery, and Markdown import work end to end.

title: Deliver the complete Markdown reading experience
description:
## What to build

Readers get safe GitHub-style Markdown, highlighted code, tables, task lists, footnotes, strict Mermaid rendering, title extraction from the first heading, and a Download .md button.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Supported Markdown constructs render reliably without allowing raw HTML or unsafe Mermaid behaviour.
- [ ] The Document title follows the first top-level heading rule and readers can download the Markdown source.

## Blocked by

- Create and read a basic Markdown Document.
acceptance_criteria: The agreed Markdown rendering and source download work end to end.

title: Bootstrap the MarkShare application
description:
## What to build

A deployable MarkShare shell on Vercel with InstantDB configuration, the agreed calm visual foundation, Light/Dark/System theme selection, and a responsive home page that starts document creation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The application runs locally and can deploy to Vercel with its required configuration documented.
- [ ] The home page provides a clear Create a document path and persists the selected System, Light, or Dark theme.

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.
acceptance_criteria: The deployable themed application shell and creation entry point work end to end.

title: Create and read a basic Markdown Document
description:
## What to build

Anyone can write Markdown in the browser, publish it without an account, receive a hard-to-guess Share Link, and open that link to read the rendered Document.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Publishing creates a persistent Document and a unique read-only Share Link.
- [ ] A visitor with the Share Link can read the rendered Document, while an unknown or unavailable link does not disclose content.

## Blocked by

- Bootstrap the MarkShare application.
acceptance_criteria: Anonymous creation and read-only sharing work end to end.

title: Add separate Edit Links and manual publishing
description:
## What to build

Authors receive a private Edit Link; the same browser remembers edit access; Share Link recipients remain read-only; edits publish only when the author saves; authors can delete a Document or replace a leaked Edit Link.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A Share Link cannot modify a Document; an Edit Link can modify, revoke, or replace it.
- [ ] The author must save changes explicitly before readers see them, and returning in the same browser restores edit access.

## Blocked by

- Create and read a basic Markdown Document.
acceptance_criteria: The separate owner editing capability works end to end.
